title: Too basic, nice interface
text: It’s nice if you are looking for a basic spending tracker for checking accounts and credit cards only. It doesn’t import transactions for brokerage accounts.

title: Ok for now
text: The app works ok but for 100 bucks it seems a little overpriced for my needs, luckily there is a 1 month free trial.All I wanted is something that shows all my outgoing and incoming funds in one place and it does do that. It has 8 tabs but I can only find 2 of them useful. The dashboard has  limited information and there is a “cashflow” tab that seems more like filler, I’m still confused on it its usefulness. If you are on a strict budget this may work for you but the graph is always showing I am over budget but the actual numbers say Im within my budget. This app has a pretty steep learning curve and set up isn’t a small task. If I find myself using this app more before my trial is up I may come back and update but if my trial were ending today, I would not be renewing.

title: Heard great things
text: Unfortunately I could only link my Chase accounts. Tried two other institutions and glitched on both on two different days. For an expensive app I expect more. Cancelled my trial immediately.

title: Not updating
text: Seems lately this app is not updating, then when you reverify accounts it adds a new account and eliminates the history.  Very frustrating.  This app is not free and it keeps going down hill.  I rely on this to track my many accounts in one location, but after a couple of years of using it, it doesn’t really help as I constantly can’t trust the information it is showing.  I will be looking for another service and not renewing this year.

title: Font too small
text: I cannot use this app on my iPhone at all - the font is way too small for me and it’s impossible to enlarge it!

title: Not impressed
text: I was supposed to get a trial. I found the app to no show data accurately and duplicated. The app did not show accounts added immediately as well. Now I canceled and have not been refunded.

title: Needs iPhone Duo optimization
text: Please update UI for iPhone Duo asap! :)

title: No optimization for iPhone Duo
text: Pretty solid app. Has the look and feel of an Apple App but it sucks to use on iPhone Duo.

title: The new AI update has ruined the experience
text:
They now spam you with notifications about if transactions their “AI” deems suspicious … it alerted me about both my monthly rent payments and my monthly car payments. 

Secondly, the chatbot experience is subpar. I have no idea how to find older conversations and it is far worse than using chatGPT. 

Also there is still no support for iPhone Duo.

title: Useless
text: Useless app. This is supposed to be an app that gives you a snapshot of your finances and the connection to Schwab accounts (and probably others) via plaid has been down for months!!

title: X Money
text: No X Money integration, each transaction must be manually entered

title: App degrades overtime. Getting worse.
text: Poor support. Used to get real humans to answer quickly now it takes DAYS to respond. The company has just gone downhill. They keep clearing my review so I’ll keep reviewing it. Used to be so smart with transactions now it makes the same errors over and over again. This app is aging. Why did rules used to work so well and now I have to fix the same transactions month after month after month. Used to be the cool new kid on the block but no functional new features for quarter after quarter. There are way better apps out there for features. Go look up Origin. Actual new features every quarter! It’s like copilot just phoned it in to make money and stopped innovating. I’m gonna let my subscription expire and go to Origin next. I could list endless issues: Stock performance data is wrong literally every single day. It’s different every single time you open the app. Amazon requires DAILY verification to load in transactions, what a joke. This app is hardly worth paying for lol. Why did the basic rules stop working? I have to fix the same charges every month. It’s like this app degrades overtime. Under yearly spend, there is an all other categories, but if you click that it goes to month view. Let me be able to see all other categories year view!

title: iPhone Duo
text: Will unsub in a month if iPhone Duo support isn’t added…

title: Don’t expect a functional app
text:
For over a year now my wife and I have been more or less completely unable to use Copilot due to ridiculous performance issues across every surface it’s available. We open the app in any device and it’s typically about 30-60 seconds before any screen is even responsive.

Once the app is sorta responsive then actually trying to do anything becomes a separate Sisyphean task. We’ve had an open support thread for literally over a year (first reported Oct 7 2025) and a number of exchanges where we’re told it’s being looked at but… not a single thing has changed.

Don’t waste your time or money, if it doesn’t work flawlessly for you out of the box, your problems won’t be addressed or resolved and you’ll just be frustrated beyond belief

title: Get rid of AI integration
text: AI does not need to know about our money. This is a disaster waiting to happen.

title: Great app but authorizations keep silently failing
text: I love this app when it works, but my credit card and bank connections keep getting unauthorized. No notice in the app that it happened and for some the reauthorizaion proceed involves much back and forth with support. Not worth the head ache

title: No AI Please
text: I recently saw Copilot is working an adding in AI.  I’m not interested in having AI agents involved in my banking.  Please give us a way to turn it off.  For the time being I’ve deleted all my accounts until I see how you’re going to build this into the app.

title: iPhone Duo Optimization
text: Not optimized for iPhone Duo

title: A $99 Trial
text:
I’m big on forgetting things, so I try to let teh computar help, but I always forget about trials that autobill you instead of simply expiring… I tried this for a day, found that it was not really great on categorizing things, so moved on with the other apps I was considering. I had to pay $99 to find out it’s not a match.

title: Horrible app
text: Gives wrong information same credit cards and same bank acount spent is shown 7100 in co pilot and 10k in nerd wallet, and nerd wallet has the correct number. And when i asked for refund they refused, waste of time and money. Dont download!!!

title: I’m done with this app
text: I’m just tired of waiting for them to let us categorize income and assign expenses to a type of income… last time using them unfortunately

title: Trying to be everything at once and bad at all
text: Budgeting feature is missing the whole point of budgeting and its UX is horrible. The app is just mediocre at all the things you need for financial tracking, it’s only good for people with simple finances and as a hub for your transactions from different accounts.

title: Tracking galore!
text: I have not had this app installed for about a year. When looking at my bank app it said copilot had accessed my account details 32 times in the last month alone. This is massively invasive.

title: Annoying slow development- no Ai Features
text: They have supposedly been working on an agent for a very long time. Nobody is able to get off their waitlist for the beta. And they hardly release any new features. They are falling far behind and I am done waiting

title: Multiple issues of connecting to institutions
text: So far I have issues with connecting to 3 well-known institutions- Bank of America, fidelity, and Merrill Lynch.  Support is slow and asking fairly silly questions.

title: Terrible UI
text: Accounts don’t link correctly and MFA locks you out of your account, overall awful experience

title: Great app, terrible ML
text: Their machine learning categorization is horrendous. It’s been this way for years, and honestly, I’m getting really tired of dealing with it..

title: Copilot money contains no AI.
text: The name is misleading. It is just a tracking app. It does not help create a budget. It’s “AI” isn’t even smart enough to pull due dates for stuff like credit cards. They are betting on the fact that it is a super pain to set up and you would not want to do that again with a real ai app. Boo this app!

title: Not worth the hassle
text: Constantly having to reconnect accounts and that process takes multiple attempts only to have accounts mislabeled or imported incorrectly. Takes less time to go back to my spreadsheet to track my finances. Was suppose to make things easier but fails.

title: The app is really bad.
text: No free trial period, forced subscription

title: Subscription model with no support
text: Support in-app doesn’t actually respond anymore. Even the AI support chatbot no longer responds.

title: Auto-Categorization is Garbage/No Ability to Payees
text:
I have never seen transaction auto-categorization perform as terribly as this. Apps I used 15 years ago did it better. There is no excuse in the age of AI. There are tons of transactions erroneously labeled as internal transfers when they are simply income or a regular purchase. I’m all for AI learning from my habits, but it doesn’t seem to know the basics.

There also doesn’t seem to be a way to rename payees so that future transactions from the same source are titled the same and have the same category. This is basic functionality that every budgeting app I’ve used has had for many years. This makes the app unusable.

And to boot, it’s also not even as beautiful as it claims to be or aligned with Apple design standards. The macOS app has clunky UX and does not inspire confidence in using it. L

title: Nice but no
text: I liked the ways you can find transactions and navigate through menus but at the same time there are too much data in the screen... Maybe due to size of fonts. I feel I spent a lot of time creating and assigning categories or fixing wrong automated categories than the time I spent in Monarch. I did not like the idea that I needed to chat in order to get a password reset. I think I  could give copilot a try in 2 years.

title: Too expensive, no new features
text: I’ve had copilot since 2021, and I’m finally canceling. Since then there have been no substantial new features, and I’m paying $96/year. In fact, the app has slowly gotten buggier over time. It’s impossible to justify spending this much money on an app that has nothing new to offer.

title: Slick UI but Extremely Convoluted Layout
text:
Looks pretty but utility is pretty low compared to other financial apps. Case in point - they show negatives in white with positive numbers! 

They need to better understand end user goals and how to enable them. Deprioritize prettiness for its own sake

title: Limited transaction history and awkward navigation
text:
Copilot looks decent, but it only imported about three months of transaction history and there doesn’t seem to be any option to import older transactions. For an app focused on spending trends, budgeting, and analytics, that’s a pretty major limitation. I want to be able to look back at a full year or more to understand my actual spending patterns.

The UI is okay overall, but the top navigation doesn’t feel very intuitive or user friendly. It takes more effort than it should to get around and find what you need.

Good concept, but historical data access and navigation need improvement.

title: Worst money waste
text: Money grabbing app. Useless app.

title: Does not auto categorize
text: I’ve had this app for 3 months and there’s only one thing I wanted it to do. I want to be able to categorize transactions automatically. This app is very very bad at that. At 3 months I still need to manually change each transaction. I canceled because it doesn’t do the most basic thing it’s supposed to do. Wave is not very good at this but 100X better than this app. I don’t understand how an app like like this is getting 5 stars ratings if the auto categorization is only 10% accurate. I wish there were a way to know if the app has improved but after I cancelled and informed the developers of the bugs that seemed to prevent all auto categorization the declined to offer me a second free trial so I can’t actually know if it works now unless I pay $30/m — as an app developer myself I’m also aware $30/m is very very expensive so maybe I’ll try to build this myself and use local LLMs and sell for a one time price.

title: DO NO RELY ON THIS APP FOR YOUR MONEY! Connections To Institutions FAIL CONSTANTLY
text: I gave this App every chance, but Connections to Financial Institutions FAILED CONSTANTLY. I worked with Support… get a connection repaired, ONLY TO FAIL AGAIN WITHIN DAYS.

title: Great visuals, but lacking
text:
What a fantastic app but it is missing a few critical items:
1. Ability to see/edit transaction rules
2. Comprehensive reporting
3. Useful and flexible investment module 
4. Multiple (and visible)  income categories

While I understand that some of these items are in keeping with the Apple experience, they are keeping me from transferring all my accounts to Copilot.

title: Doesn’t work as it used to
text: I used to love this app, but now it’s not working as it’s meant to be. I have submitted multiple tickets and they always give me the same answer as they’re working on fixing it but it’s been the same issues for the whole year. They had added a goal for spending so it doesn’t affect your current budget but that feature is a joke. Since I first added a goal to a transaction all of my budgets have been wrong. I can’t even tell how much I’m spending and how much is left accurately to spend for the rest of the month. I’m just waiting for my subscription to run out and go find another app. It’s disappointing since I have used this for many years and this year it’s the first time where they haven’t updated and fixed these big issues.

title: From 5 to 3 stars
text:
I love the interface because it’s colorful and easy to navigate. It’s so easy to categorize transactions and see where all of your money is. The rollover feature is perfect for me rather than having to track individual sinking funds. It didn’t take long to set up at all, and it shows me everything I need without having to run reports or search for it, such as the average amount I’m spending per category per month, which updates automatically. I’m switching from YNAB, and I hated the give every dollar a job model. In Copilot Money, you don’t have to move assigned dollars between categories every time money moves between your accounts. This app has given me the flexibility I need in my budget while still maintaining control over my finances. My one suggestion is to add an auto-distribute function for splitting transactions so I don’t have to manually calculate sales tax for each category.

EDIT: I have canceled my free trial and will be going back to spreadsheets. So far the customer support has been good. One of my accounts will not connect and they have been working diligently to resolve the issue - much appreciated. However, I discovered that a bunch of my transactions are missing. Initially, when I connected my accounts, it imported 2 1/2 years worth of data. I had to manually delete everything prior to this year, which was difficult because I kept trying to delete things and they wouldn’t disappear so I had to do it repeatedly. Now I’m discovering that most of my categories are missing transactions between January and April 2026. I tried entering them manually but it’s a bit tedious. I can’t customize the color of the accounts and when I search for them, the font is too small so it’s difficult to find the one I’m looking for plus they always come up in a different order. I also don’t like that I cannot re-order my categories or my recurrings. Speaking of recurrings, the app is not recognizing new transactions, even though I have set up a rule for the name. Some of my recurrings are duplicated and I can’t rename them. Visually the list is a mess. In addition, I have to agree with other users that there is no easy way to see what is available to spend. I find myself toggling back-and-forth between the cash flow tab, the dashboard and my categories but still not feeling certain about the information it’s giving me. Yesterday I was reviewing new transactions and one of them was categorized incorrectly even though I have at least five other transactions from the same place. When I re-categorized it, I found that all the previous transactions were also categorized incorrectly, even though I’ve already gone through every single transaction in my history and made sure that it was right. Somehow it got changed? I really like the layout of this app and at first it seemed great but now I’m finding too many functional errors.

title: Issues prevent me from using
text: I want to like this app. I really want to like it. It promises so many great things. Unfortunately, if you do not have one of the major five banks, you will probably have issues. I have a small, smaller credit union, and and there are constant issues with syncing, correct balances, and just getting it to work in general. I downloaded this in spent more time talking with support than I have actually using the app. If the issues I’m experiencing aren’t fixed by canceling my subscription.

title: confusing
text: annoying and hard to allocate funds not spent

title: Never an improvement
text: Some features are great but it’s stuck in a specific place. Doesn’t work well for a couple; doesn’t have much budgeting flexibility — do it their way or don’t bother. And once you sign up it’s hard to get it to go away. Not that they keep making you pay - you just get ghost messages about stuff forever.

title: Imports all transactions as credits
text: The app imports all transactions from my bank as credits, including transactions where I’m paying someone else such as my power bill. This has been the case for most of 2026. Discussing the issue via the in-app support feature lead to agreement that the issue is present and then nothing, several months ago. Obviously my transactions showing as credits makes it nigh impossible to budget.

title: Basic math is missing
text:
If you want to be able to see income-expenses=balance, this app isn’t for you. If you want a flashy dashboard that just shows how much you spent and you don’t really care to do the math, you’ll love it. If you’re actually budgeting, this is worthless. 
Update: I stand by my comments, the cash flow section is for the past, I want to also be able to budget for the future. I need the math on the budget.

title: Back to Monarch
text: I gave this a try for a year after monarch. This app looks great, but it fails to update and sync even if forced. The desktop app on Mac is trash.

title: Broken
text: Buggy, inconsistent connections with your financial accounts that require constant troubleshooting and nannying. Defeats the point of the app.

title: Apple Card accounts never work
text: Despite repeated conversations with customer support, Apple Card transactions just don’t work. They’ll appear after adding the account (the first or the nth time), but after some random period they stop updating. If you have an Apple Card, this effectively makes Copilot worthless for tracking expenses. I’ve waited through several updates for a fix that hasn’t arrived. Time to check out alternatives.

title: Does almost nothing
text: Anyone can log in to see transactions and balances.  There is nothing special about this app.  It's a waste of time to set it up.

title: Stay Far \ Away
text: Don’t bother with this. There are so many issues. I can’t change the amount spend for the month. It’s constantly doubling my bills without a single transaction showing. I can’t adjust backwards on my saving goals. It doesn’t save the categories transactions are saved to. It’s a nightmare. I spend more time trying to fix transactions than I do tracking. And I can’t even fix most of the mistakes this stupid app makes. Im just stuck with it and hope its not an issue next month

title: No refund after free trial

The apple support team raised their hands and asked me to make better decision in my life. The free trial is just to lure you in as you always forget to cancel the free trial.
